description: OTC foreign exchange turnover by currency, net-net basis, all instruments, all reporting and counterparty countries, daily average in April 2025 (BIS Triennial Central Bank Survey 2025)
method: BIS SDMX v2 data API (CSV, keyless), dataflow WS_DER_OTC_TOV, one request
notes: Each trade involves two currencies, so currency shares of the TO1 total sum to two hundred percent.
Ranking and shares are derived in the models (pipeline.models.load.bis_fx_turnover).
path_note: Stored under data/raw/bis_fx/ rather than data/raw/bis/ (the methodology's path) so the monthly freshness rule on data/raw/bis/*.csv does not mark a triennial survey stale.
refresh: re-downloaded every run (one request); a failed request keeps the previous file
